title: eupatorium perfoliatum var. truncatum
intro: Eupatorium perfoliatum var. truncatum, commonly known as Joe Pye Weed, is a perennial plant native to eastern North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. Joe Pye Weed is said to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and ease congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
